A [[Suspicious Hermit]] lives in the northeastern corner of [[Zehlon Reach]] with his pet [[Irontooth Drake]] that he calls "Nund". If you approach them, the hermit will start his quote lines telling you to back off. Once he uses up all of his lines, both the hermit and his pet will turn hostile.

==Locations==
*[[Istan]]
**{{NPC location|Zehlon Reach}} (northeastern corner)

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Healing Signet}}

==Quotes==
Approaching him will trigger the following lines one after another until he turns hostile:
:''"You! Back off! You're invading my personal space!"
:''"Leave me alone in my happy place! Yes, father. I hear you. They're all bad, I know."
:''"Nund, why does no one listen to me? I just want to be left alone to my own devices. Is that so wrong? Dear sweet Nund, we are an island in a sea of heretics!"
:''"Nund, Attack!"

==Notes==
*It has been [[User_talk:Linsey_Murdock/Lore1#Zehlon_Reach|confirmed]] that the hermit is a scrapped part of the quest [[A Father's Fate]].
